captions.detailed: A compact, black office monitor featuring a slim-bezel rectangular screen panel, mounted on a telescoping center mast that rises from a flat rectangular base with rounded corners. The screen panel is attached to the top of the mast via a rear tilt bracket, allowing the display to pivot on a horizontal axis. Underneath the bottom right edge of the screen bezel, a small cylindrical control wheel is mounted on a short shaft, designed to rotate continuously.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact office monitor on a height-adjustable stand. The model must feature a flat rectangular base, a telescoping vertical mast, a rear tilt bracket, a slim-bezel screen panel, and a small control wheel under the lower-right bezel. Ensure the telescoping mast has a prismatic joint, the screen has a revolute tilt hinge, and the control wheel has a continuous rotation joint.
captions.factory: The model is built by defining an ArticulatedObject with several parts. First, the base is constructed using a box with rounded edges, which is joined to a hollow rectangular lower mast. Second, the telescoping upper mast is built from a smaller rectangular box and connected to the lower mast via a prismatic joint. Third, a tilt bracket is modeled from a box and attached to the upper mast using a revolute joint for pitch adjustment. Fourth, the screen assembly (bezel and panel) is modeled as a thin box and fixed to the tilt bracket. Finally, a small cylinder representing the control wheel is created and attached under the bottom-right corner of the screen bezel using a continuous rotation joint.
